layer_rules.rule: モジュール名が次の固定集合に一致: KernelAlgebra, FiniteJet, BetaKernel, IntegralJet, TaylorEnvelope, CoefficientEvaluator, NumericalGate, RationalEvaluator, RationalBounds, FixedCertificate
モジュール名が次の固定集合に一致（PRZZ 公理とその直接の帰結）: PRZZInterface, PRZZAsymptotic

接頭辞 `PRZZ`（上の固定集合を除く）。細分は `PRZZ` を除いた残りの接頭辞で: L0 入力（Weil / DI の仕様） = KloostermanInputs; L1 近似関数等式と Poisson = AFE, Poisson, CoupledAFE, ContourAFE, SeriesAFE, IntegratedAFE, IntegratedFreezeAFE, ReconstructedAFE, ExhaustiveAFE, PrunedAFE, LiteralAFE, DiscardedAFE, AllPoisson, Congruence, L1, Moment, BodyTail; L2 算術分解（A*, Type I/II, Weil–DI） = AStar, Actual, Active, TypeI, TypeII, Weil, DI, Sharp, HeathBrown, HB, Kloosterman, Cases, Allocation, Lambda, Nu, Gcd, Arithmetic, Mobius; それ以外 = 細分未割当

接頭辞が次のいずれか: Conrey, Feng, Gcd, ElementaryGcd, Coprime, Totient, Mobius, Euler, BareEuler, RawEuler, Shifted, Shift, Smooth, Expanded, TwoPiece, ZetaMoment, ZetaPole, Height, Arithmetic, CompactShift, Outer, LogProfile, Multiplicative, Support, Weight, Endpoint, Witness, Cauchy
上のどれにも当たらないローカルモジュール（一覧に列挙）
`import Mathlib...` をまとめた外部ノード
`import Zeta23...`（固定コミットの AF ライブラリ）をまとめた外部ノード

grouping_rules: Assign each reachable module to a summary group. Rules (documented in the .md):
1. Layers other than 主項/計数 form one group each.
2. 主項 and 計数 are grouped by the first CamelCase word of the module name.
3. A first-word group with >= SPLIT_MIN members is split by its first two words
when that gives <= SPLIT_MAX_SUBGROUPS subgroups of size >= 2 and the
leftover singletons are fewer than half of the group.
4. Within a layer, groups with exactly one module merge into "<layer>: 単独".
